title: Verify local and self-hosted migration readiness
businessObjective: Provide evidence that approved provider changes can replace adapters/configuration without rewriting domain logic or weakening governance.
technicalObjective: Exercise deterministic reference composition/fixture migration scenarios for persistence, orchestration, runners, intelligence providers, and retention-transfer eligibility; do not transfer data or provision services.
assumptions: Verification uses fixtures/reference adapters only; no production account, data, credentials, cutover, deletion, archival, or transfer.
acceptanceCriteria: Evidence exercises replacement paths for Supabase/PostgreSQL, Workers/local/VPS, Cloudflare/Pi queues/workflows, hosted/self-hosted runners, and hosted/local intelligence through adapters/configuration.
It proves core/domain code is unchanged and provider SDK imports remain adapter-only.
Migration readiness includes a bounded future transfer, rollback, retention, audit, authentication, failure-boundary, and P3-005 transfer-eligibility checklist; it performs none of those actions.
Missing adapter capability, retention lifecycle evidence, metering authority, or migration authority fails closed and produces no cutover claim.
requiredChecks: exact validator admission before independent verification
solEscalationTriggers: Any actual migration, account/provider provisioning, credential transfer, data copy, deletion, archival, local transfer, or production cutover.
rollbackExpectations: Revert fixtures/docs/tests only and preserve all evidence.

stateTransitions.reason: Created by GOV-043 for migration-readiness evidence only.
